I2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; O2=G['Demo pair 2 output']

# hypothesis: find most common non-bg color (the shape), keep all its cells, remove others
def solve(g,bg):
    c=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=bg)
    main=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bg]*len(row) for row in g]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        for cc,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==main: out[r][cc]=v
    return out
